name: lb3-0.5b-v1
note: Draft corpus for #40 (0.5B, ~100B tokens), LB3 of the 2026-10-23 leaderboard review. Weights are a starting point for the 100M A/B, not tuned. No licence here is verified yet: huggingface.co is blocked in the cloud container, so each dataset card must be read from a network that reaches it before license_verified is set. distill-d1 is small today (the D1 pilot is ~20k prompts), so its decay share repeats it several times; raise it only after D1 is scaled up. zhwiki's budget also exceeds one epoch of zh Wikipedia.
